mission: Establish the Ben/Desh dynamic aboard the Steady Returns — the easy rhythm of old friends who don't discuss the elephant in the cockpit
why_now: Transit to first survey world; the reader needs to see the relationship baseline before it's tested
conflict: The unspoken GAG history hangs between them — they're comfortable but careful, bonded by shared shame neither names
turning_point: Desh makes a dry observation about the ship's sensors reading the wrongness as instrument error — the practical man acknowledging the mystical problem
opening_hook: The Steady Returns handles like a ship that's been repaired more times than it was originally built, and Desh flies it the same way — compensation through experience
closing_hook: First survey world on scanners. The wrongness intensifies. Ben's hands tighten on the copilot's armrest.
emotional_trajectory: Comfortable familiarity -> careful humor -> growing tension

stakes.personal: Ben's reliance on Desh as a safe relationship — no Force, no betrayal risk
stakes.interpersonal: The unprocessed GAG history between them
stakes.external: The wrongness is getting stronger as they move along the bearing

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns in hyperspace — cramped cockpit, lived-in freighter
sensory_details: Recycled air smell; Desh's coffee; instrument panels jury-rigged with non-standard components; hyperspace blue through the viewport
notes: Allston-channel humor. Desh is a warm absence in Ben's Force-awareness — the first time the reader experiences what it's like for Ben to be around someone who doesn't register in the Force.
